text: The purpose of this Motion is to transmit the report from the City Manger to recommend to City Council the appointment of an Interim Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer. This motion is urgent because the position of Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer will be vacant effective July 5, 2023.

City Council on June 14 and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Stephen Conforti as the Interim Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer for the City of Toronto and as Interim Statutory Treasurer, with all the powers and duties imposed by Chapter 169, City Officials of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, and under Section 138 of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 , effective the latter of July 5, 2023 and such date when Stephen Conforti enters into an employment contract for the position of Interim Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer and until such time as a new Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer has been appointed. 2. City Council authorize the City Solicitor to introduce the necessary By-laws to give effect to City Council's decision.
